name: Fukusaki (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Fukusaki town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Fukusaki, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 July 1957.

features.role: Fukusaki town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of curved strokes
